text:
molly: Heads-up — planning to ship Console UI changes at 17:30 PT today. Small CSS + bundle bump. Who's owning the deploy and CDN invalidation? Need a quick smoke pass and rollback readiness. 

alex: I can do CDN invalidation. Are we purging the whole console prefix or just specific assets? What's cache TTL? 

molly: Prefer prefix purge for /console/* only. TTLs are normal (max-age 300 for assets). We'll do a canary to 5% first then ramp over 10 mins. 

tim: I can watch the rollout and run smoke tests. Which checks are in scope? 

jamie: Smoke checklist: 1) login flow on canary 2) open Console, run key pages (models, jobs) 3) check token usage UI for render regressions 4) run `yarn build && yarn start --smoke` locally against canary endpoint. 

alex: OK I'll run the purge. Command I'll use:
```
curl -X POST "https://infra-api.redwood.internal/cdn/purge" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CDN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"paths":["/console/*"],"env":"prod"}'
```
I'll post the invalidation id here when done. 

deploy-bot: Snapshot created: build-20260317-1722 (hash: a1b2c3). Canary slot reserved: canary-7. 

tim: I'll kick off the canary deploy at 17:30 PT, watch error rate + frontend render errors, and have the previous bundle pinned for immediate revert. If anything > 2% JS errors or auth failures, we rollback. 

molly: Rollback plan: flip traffic back to `build-20260312-1501`, run a quick smoke pass (tim/jamie), and then run CDN purge on /console/* to ensure cached assets are correct. 

alex: Invalidation started — id `inv-987654`. ETA ~60s global. 

jamie: I'll run smoke tests as soon as canary reports healthy. Posting quick checklist results here. 

molly: Thanks all — locking window. Ping me if you need escalations. :thumbsup:
